newsitem.title: CHINA: Inflation falls in China's Tibet region in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Inflation falls in China's Tibet region in 1996.

text.p: Retail price inflation in China's remote Himalayan region of Tibet fell by 10.4 percentage points in 1996 and consumer price inflation was down by 11.9 percentage points, the China Business Daily said on Thursday.
That performance was among the best in Tibet in recent years, the newspaper said, without giving a specific figure.

Local officials reached by telephone said the rate of inflation in the remote region, where prices are generally higher than in the rest of China because of poor infrastructure and high transport costs, was a state secret.
